rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it introduces uncertainty by calling it closer to stage 4 and downgrading TE toward B despite the provided lab grade of 3AA.

Generally aligned with Gardner morphology principles and standard IVF prognostic reasoning, though the stage/grade reinterpretation from the image is somewhat less tightly aligned with the stated laboratory grade.
